purpose: Record the bounded n8n readiness and governance invariants present in this current-main candidate; repository receipts describe source truth and do not prove live GitHub, Cloudflare, n8n, or production provider state.

claims: .github/workflows/cloudflare-build-diagnostic.yml: the exact-current-main Worker Git authority audit must require the dedicated read-only Workers Builds user token for its primary provider readback; request-trace and DNS-inventory remain optional evidence lanes, and whether they are missing, malformed, or provider-rejected they may retain their own bounded evidence/error but cannot downgrade or upgrade the snapshotted core authority ok/error verdict; absence of a core receipt must never manufacture authority, and the workflow remains read-only and cannot authorize provider mutation.

.github/workflows/n8n-runtime-integration-proof.yml: CI-only n8n runtime proof must mask generated bearer and encryption credentials before exporting them to later steps, while keeping the runtime ephemeral and non-production-authorizing.

src/http/routes/n8nConveyor.ts: founder-authenticated conveyor readiness must resolve retained activation proof against the deployed exact GIT_SHA and must fail closed instead of claiming live verification when proof is missing, stale, or unreadable.

wrangler.worker.toml: every canonical Worker build must execute the repository build-authority membrane; native Cloudflare Workers Builds may proceed only through non-promoting versions upload while production promotion remains bounded to the exact manual GitHub authority path.

src/http/routes/n8nConveyor.ts: authenticated conveyor readiness must resolve retained activation proof at request time and may report live only when the persisted activation receipt is bound to the deployed exact GIT_SHA; stale, missing, or unreadable proof must remain non-live, and no credential value may be exposed.

.github/workflows/quality-gate.yml: pull-request Quality Gate jobs must checkout and verify the exact github.event.pull_request.head.sha; a successful synthetic merge-ref run is merge-simulation evidence and cannot satisfy exact-head candidate proof.

src/providers/GitHubProvider.ts: canonical FCR integration must retain provider-backed reviewed PR context, revalidate exact base/head authority, use GitHub's pull-request merge endpoint without generic protected-branch fallback, keep strict status/current-base freshness in a zero-bypass ruleset, constrain the trusted App review bypass to pull_request mode, retain provider identities after partial mutation, and preserve GitHub Check Run App issuer identity without fabricating it.

src/providers/RepositoryProvider.ts: verification signals must carry provider-backed GitHub App issuer identity when GitHub supplies it so deterministic review can distinguish the trusted evidence producer from a same-name green check produced by another or unknown issuer; the provider must never fabricate issuer trust when GitHub omits that identity.

src/review/independentReviewGate.ts: canonical founder-final deterministic review requires numeric server-owned GITHUB_APP_ID and accepts the expected exact-head green GitHub witness only when its provider-backed App issuer matches that trusted identity; missing runtime identity, missing issuer, or mismatched issuer fails closed, while live GitHub ruleset enforcement remains separate provider truth.

README.md: deterministic review authenticates the exact-head Check Run producer against server-owned GITHUB_APP_ID while preserving live GitHub ruleset enforcement as a separate provider fact that still requires provider readback.
